title: Cross-Team Tactical Capacity Snapshot — Mar 2025
content:
Purpose: quick ad-hoc spreadsheet to surface cross-team low-friction items that need reallocation or expedited attention over the next 2 weeks. Not comprehensive — meant for standups + weekly ops sync.

Legend: Impact = H/M/L; Est = estimated remaining effort in hours; ETA = date owner expects to hand off or close; Blocker tags: infra / vendor / legal / dependency.

COLUMNS: Item | Owner | Team | Est (hrs) | Blocker | Impact | Next action | ETA | Notes

1) Upgrade kv-cache library to 1.4.2 | Diego Morales | serving-runtime | 18 | infra (CI flakes) | H | Diego to pair with infra for CI fixes; try flaky-test skip | 2025-03-18 | Partial backport PR ready (gh:pr/487) — need infra env token.

2) Dedicated onboarding checklist (customer: BrightGrid) | Claire Nguyen | solutions-eng | 6 | dependency (sales) | M | Claire to confirm legal checklist completed + kickoff call schedule | 2025-03-17 | Sales rep Sasha to confirm SOW sign-off.

3) Console: per-route latency chart bug | Emma Park | console-and-rollouts | 12 | vendor (metrics library) | H | Raise support ticket with vendor, add temporary client-side aggregation | 2025-03-19 | Affects SLA dashboard for Dedicated customers. Customer notice drafted.

4) Private deploy validation for EU region | Ben Ortiz | private-deployments | 24 | compliance review | H | Ben to send validation pack to security; block until sec review done | 2025-03-26 | Security requested additional audit logs (sec-req-77).

5) Embedding cost-sample analysis (one-off) | Aisha Kumar | product-hosted-api | 8 | none | M | Complete calc & share with growth for pricing test | 2025-03-14 | Quick sensitivity table included in notes.

6) SRE on-call shift gap (Mar 20–24) | Diego Morales | site-reliability-engineering | 4 | resourcing | M | Find 1 backup from infra team; update rota | 2025-03-13 | Potentially use contractor hours.

7) Quick audit of model-variant tagging consistency | Emma Park | serving-runtime | 10 | dependency (data) | L | Small script to list mismatches + assign owners | 2025-03-20 | Could be automated next quarter.

8) Customer feedback triage: rate limit complaints | Claire Nguyen | customer-success | 6 | none | H | Pull recent 30-day logs, route to product for throttle tuning | 2025-03-16 | Two customers on Dedicated; escalate if SLA impacted.

9) Small UX tweak: rollout modal copy | Ben Ortiz | developer-experience | 2 | none | L | Ben to make copy change and ship canary | 2025-03-12 | Low risk, quick win.\n
10) Billing CSV parser anomaly (edge case with negative credits) | Aisha Kumar | finance-and-legal | 14 | dependency (billing service) | H | Patch parser, add unit tests, coordinate with billing infra | 2025-03-21 | Replicate case with test file billing-sample-neg.csv.

---
Quick summary / actionable items: 
- Total open items: 10
- High-impact (H): 5 items (kv-cache, console latency, private deploy validation, rate limit triage, billing parser)
- Average est remaining: ~11.9 hrs (quick average)
- Immediate blockers: infra CI token, security audit logs, vendor metrics support, sales SOW confirmation.

Recommended short playbook (for next ops sync):
- Prioritize infra-blocked items in first 48 hours: Diego + infra dedicate 4h/day until CI green.
- Assign an owner for security audit backlog: Ben to coordinate with security and confirm expected deliverables by 2025-03-20.
- Quick wins (<=4h) to clear: UX copy, SRE rota, onboarding checklist follow-ups.

Unresolved questions / notes-to-self: 
- Can we borrow 8h from infra sprint B to help with kv-cache backport without derailing sprint goals? (ask @Liu in PM sync)
- Are we comfortable shipping the console SLA dashboard with a temporary client-side fix? Document rollback plan.
- Should finance create a small test harness for recurring billing edge cases? (low-effort investment)

Versioning: this is ephemeral — copy into product-ops repo if it becomes a formal tracker.

History: created during cross-team morning huddle 2025-03-11; updated with vendor response + SOW status on 2025-03-15.

Quick links / artifacts referenced:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/487
- Billing sample: drive:/shared_drives/company/misc/billing-sample-neg.csv
- Slack thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C03ABCD1234/p1710203456000200

TO DO (short):
- [ ] Diego: confirm infra token ETA (by 3/13)
- [ ] Ben: book security sync + confirm audit log spec (by 3/14)
- [ ] Claire: confirm BrightGrid SOW status (by 3/14)
- [ ] Emma: open vendor support ticket + paste ticket link here (by 3/13)
- [ ] Aisha: finish embedding cost sample & send to growth (by 3/14)

Notes to future reader: this doc was intentionally lightweight — treat as an operational snapshot, not canonical project plan. If item grows, move to a dedicated sheet or Jira ticket and link back.
